confirmed_corrections: p8: five bands use THREE significant digits, multiplier and tolerance
p18: general parallel formula is reciprocal sum; product/sum is only two resistors
p52(e): drawing labels voltmeter A; actual function is parallel voltage measurement with reversed polarity
p185-186 Q129: load bridges left and right upper nodes. Left open voltage8V; right-6V; Vth14V. Rth=(3k||6k)+2k=4kOhm. Pmax12.25mW at4kOhm. Printed topology simplification is invalid.
p188 Q130: second contribution7/(2200+1000||3300)=2.358934mA, not2.596mA; full signed source topology must remain explicit.
